hooks.repairPrice: Gold per hull point repaired. A perk on it at an island also lets the hull be repaired there.
hooks.sailUpgradePrice: Gold for a sail upgrade at a shipyard.
hooks.shipPrice: Gold for a new ship at a shipyard.
hooks.helpReward: Help orders' reward factor (a town asking for help pays this times the usual).
hooks.discoverRange: How close a hidden island must be to show on the chart, in map units.
hooks.hullDamage: Hull points lost when striking a reef, a shore or a pier.
hooks.storageRoom: Crates the captain can keep at an island between voyages (0: none).
hooks.forecastSec: How far ahead the wind is shown under the compass, in seconds (0: no forecast).
